wins: Achieved positive total reward in the single episode
fails: No episode-level success achieved (0% success rate)
High mentor call usage relative to episode count
key_outcomes.summary: Single-episode run with positive reward but no successful completion; needs focus on converting partial progress into full success and reducing mentor dependence.

skill_cards.if_condition: When early actions yield positive reward without completing the episode
skill_cards.then_action: Extend the current tactic chain to a defined end-state objective before switching tools

skill_cards.if_condition: When mentor calls exceed 5 in a single episode
skill_cards.then_action: Insert a consolidation phase: summarize current evidence and attempt one independent next action

memory_ops.reason: Positive reward indicates partial tactic effectiveness; reinforcing completion behavior may convert to success.

next_experiments.title: Completion-First Tactic Chain
next_experiments.description: Force a minimal end-to-end chain by adding a fixed success-condition check every 3 steps before tool switching.

next_experiments.title: Mentor Call Budgeting
next_experiments.description: Cap mentor calls at 3 per episode and require a self-derived next step after each call.

next_experiments.title: Reward-to-Success Bridging
next_experiments.description: Identify actions that yielded reward and attempt adjacent actions that explicitly target the success condition.
